:::{.theorem data-title="Lebesgue's Dominated Convergence Theorem"}

Assume that $X_{n}\stackrel{\mathbb{P}}{\to}X$ and that $|X_{n}|\leq Y$ with
$\mathbb{E}[Y]<\infty$. Then $\mathbb{E}[X_{n}] \to \mathbb{E}[X]$.

:::
